question: 不同渠道下单用户分布情况
gold_sql: select c.channel_name, count(distinct o.user_id) from orders o left join channels c on o.channel_id = c.channel_id group by c.channel_name
raw_output:
SELECT c.channel_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS user_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) * 1.0 /
             (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'), 4) AS user_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN channels c ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY user_count DESC;
